The wait between the first two seasons of "Severance" has already been long, and the third season is testing everyone's patience in the same way, but Apple TV has just revealed news about the show's progress that is worth noting.

"Severance" Season 3 officially begins filming, with a premiere expected at the end of 2027

It has been approximately 18 months since "Severance" Season 2 first premiered. Although progress on Season 3 has not been ideal, it has just reached an important milestone.

According to a post by Ben Stiller on X, retweeted by the Apple TV account, "Severance" Season 3 has officially started filming.

The low-resolution production photo Stiller shared appears to show Mark S. and Helly R. running in a Lumon corridor, a scene reminiscent of the one at the end of Season 2.

Season 2 ended with Mark's shocking decision — he chose to stay with Helly, going against his "outie"'s original plan to reunite with Gemma, setting the stage for a series of compelling events in Season 3.

There was a three-year gap between Seasons 1 and 2 of "Severance." Various factors were involved during this period, including script rewrites, reshoots, and the Hollywood strikes.

If Season 3 takes six to nine months to film, followed by approximately half a year of post-production, "Severance" is likely to return in autumn 2027. In that case, it would be just a few months short of the three-year cycle.

When do you expect "Severance" Season 3 to premiere? Feel free to let us know in the comments.

Apple TV's monthly subscription fee is US$12.99, and it can also be purchased through the Apple One bundle discount.
